variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Dried chicken meat (30%), tapioca (20%), hydrolysed salmon protein, dried peas, pea fibre, dried duck meat (7%), inactive brewer’s yeast, animal fat (chicken oil) , fish oil (salmon oil) , potato protein, xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS 0.4%), minerals, psyllium husks (0.5%), Yucca schidigera , products and by-products derived from the processing of fresh fruits and vegetables (melon juice concentrate – Cucumis melo cantalupensis – source of superoxide dismutase 0.005%), milk protein powder. *Refined to 99.6%, preserved with natural antioxidants. **Sources of carbohydrates.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 35%, crude fibre 8%, crude fat 10%, crude ash 7%, starch 25%, total sugars 6.2%, n-3 fatty acids 0.42%, n-6 fatty acids 1.87%.

Additives: Nutritional additives: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate) 25,000 IU, vitamin D3 1,750 IU, selenium (sodium selenate 0.25 mg) 0.11 mg, manganese (manganese sulphate monohydrate 72 mg) 23 mg, copper (copper(II) sulphate pentahydrate 36 mg) 9 mg, iron (iron(II) sulphate monohydrate 234 mg) 77 mg, iodine (anhydrous calcium iodate 6.8 mg) 4.45 mg, L-carnitine 100 mg, taurine 2,500 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Tocopherol extracts from vegetable oils.
